description:
WHAT: Runs the Fairquery Apify Actor osv-dependency-vulnerability-check: parses package.json, package-lock.json (v1-v3), requirements.txt or go.mod (or a package list), checks OSV, and returns per-package max severity/CVSS, fixed versions, a recommended upgrade version and one row per vulnerability (deduped aliases).
WHEN: Only for manifests, severity filtering or fix recommendations: full project audits from a pasted manifest, CI-style reports; for a few exact versions use osv_query_packages (free).
WHEN NOT: Quick checks of a few exact versions (osv_query_packages, free) or one advisory (osv_get_vulnerability, free).
COST: Paid, billed to YOUR Apify account via your APIFY_TOKEN: $0.0005 per package + $0.0015 per vulnerability found (+ $0.00005/run). Use minSeverity="HIGH" to cut vuln rows. lodash+django (2 pkgs, 41 vulns) ~ $0.06.
RETURNS: Paged rows type="package" (vulnerable, vuln_count, max_severity, fixed_versions, recommended_version), type="vulnerability" (id, cve_ids, severity, cvss_score, fixed_versions, osv_url) or type="error". Tool errors: INPUT_EMPTY, APIFY_TOKEN_MISSING, APIFY_TOKEN_INVALID, APIFY_PAYMENT_REQUIRED, APIFY_ACTOR_RUN_FAILED, APIFY_TIMEOUT.
BEHAVIOR: Makes network calls: runs an Apify Actor (querying OSV.dev) in your account; latency seconds to minutes (300 s timeout). Up to 1000 packages or a 2,000,000-char manifest.
PARAMETERS: packages or manifestText = input (one required); manifestType = format, default auto-detect; minSeverity = only report at/above ALL|LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL (default ALL); includeDevDependencies (default true); limit = page size (default 100, max 1000); offset = items to skip for paging (default 0).
EXAMPLE: {"manifestText":"django==3.2.0\nrequests==2.19.0","minSeverity":"HIGH"}

includeDevDependencies.description: Optional boolean, default true. false skips devDependencies (package.json) and dev packages (package-lock.json); no effect on requirements.txt / go.mod

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-1000 (default 100). Example: 50

manifestText.description: Optional if packages is given. Raw file content (<= 2,000,000 chars) of package.json, package-lock.json (v1-v3), requirements.txt (== pins) or go.mod; parsed packages are added to packages. Example: "django==3.2.0\nrequests==2.19.0"

manifestType.description: Optional, one of "auto" | "package.json" | "package-lock.json" | "requirements.txt" | "go.mod", default "auto" (detect from content). Set it when detection fails (MANIFEST_UNDETECTED)

minSeverity.description: Optional, one of "ALL" | "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH" | "CRITICAL", default "ALL". Only emit (and bill) vulnerability rows at or above this severity; package rows are always emitted. Example: "HIGH"

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

packages.description: Optional if manifestText is given (at least one is required). 0-1000 {ecosystem, name, version} objects with exact versions; billed per package. Example: [{"ecosystem":"npm","name":"lodash","version":"4.17.20"}]

ecosystem.description: Required, 1-40 chars, case-insensitive. One of npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist, Pub, Hex; aliases node, pip, python, golang, java, cargo, rust, gem, ruby, composer accepted. Example: "npm"

name.description: Required, 1-300 chars. Package name exactly as published: npm "lodash" or "@scope/pkg", PyPI "django", Go module path "github.com/gin-gonic/gin", Maven "groupId:artifactId" e.g. "org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core"

version.description: Required, 1-100 chars. One exact version without range operators or "v" prefix, e.g. "4.17.20" (not "^4.17.0"); Go uses "v1.9.0"

name: osv_audit_dependencies

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Audit dependencies/manifests with fix recommendations (paid)
